title: Recovery of fine.–When a sentence of fine is imposed by a Force Court under section 49, a copy
text:
140. Recovery of fine.–When a sentence of fine is imposed by a Force Court under section 49, a copy
of such sentence signed and certified by the confirming officer, or where no confirmation is required, by
the officer holding the trial may be sent to any magistrate in India, and such magistrate shall thereupon
cause the fine to be recovered in accordance with the provisions of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973
(2 of 1974), as if it were a sentence of fine imposed by such magistrate.
